1.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

2.t: from the evil of whatever He has created

3.t: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark

4.t: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots

5.t: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”
